_notes.home: Your own city: label is the city name the page shows, zone is its time zone name (like Europe/Lisbon). workStart and workEnd are the hours you usually work, from 0 to 24; they default to 9 and 17.
_notes.people: One row per person, in the order the page shows them: their name, the city they are in, its time zone name, and the hours they usually work there (17.5 is half past five). color is optional, like "#e0457b", and tints their work hours and their clock's seconds hand.
_notes.theme: day (white page, bright strips), night (black page, softer strips, brighter glow), or auto, which follows the system's light or dark setting.
